Plans & itineraries

Budget travel to Pantai Carocok

A budget trip needs separating fixed costs from changing ones. This page helps plan without promising prices.

Updated · 27 November 2026

Components

What to budget

Separate transport, retribution/parking, food, and water activities. Each has a different price source.

  • Transport: depends on mode from Padang/Painan.
  • Retribution/parking: confirm at the gate.
  • Food: varies; pick simple stalls.

Save

How to reduce

Bring your own water, choose local snacks, and combine land activities to avoid paid ones.

Do not guess prices

Regulation No. 9/2023 reference: admission Rp10,000 per adult and Rp5,000 per child per entry. Check the counter rate and budget separately for parking and activities.

Reserve

Always keep

Keep a reserve for plan or weather changes.

Questions

Before you go

01How much does Carocok cost?+

Start with the Regulation No. 9/2023 admission reference: Rp10,000 per adult and Rp5,000 per child per entry. Add transport, parking, food and activities, checking rates on arrival.

02What is the cheapest way?+

Bring your own water, check menu prices, and choose walking or photographs after site admission without adding a water-activity package.

03Is entry free?+

Regulation No. 9/2023 lists paid admission. Use Rp10,000 per adult and Rp5,000 per child as references and check the official counter rate.

04Including children?+

Regulation No. 9/2023 lists Rp5,000 per child per entry. Ask the counter about age limits and exemptions.
